verdict.rationale: OCI's Getting Started guide has official tutorials to launch an instance, build a load balancer and get started with the CLI. The CLI install docs show exact commands, Cloud Shell comes with a pre-configured CLI, and a free trial or Always Free tier lowers the cost of a first deploy. One community user reports instances working out of the box with SSH. However, nothing shows a quickstart going from zero to a running service with every command listed, or any time-to-first-deploy figure. Missing for 10: an evidenced end-to-end quickstart with exact commands for deploying a running service, evidence of first deploy in under an hour, and independent hands-on reports of the onboarding time.
